name: klew
description: Read-only Kubernetes troubleshooting: investigations, logs, events, rollout changes and much more.

kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig
kubeconfig.description: Path to the kubeconfig file. Leave empty for KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.

context.title: Default kube context
context.description: Context to use when Claude does not name one. Leave empty for the kubeconfig's current context.

no_log_samples.title: Leave out log samples
no_log_samples.description: Keep raw container log text out of results. Log patterns, counts and other evidence are still returned.

extensions_dir.title: Extensions folder
extensions_dir.description: Folder of your own Collector and Rule YAML files. Leave empty for Klew's own extensions folder and the folders linked in the Klew desktop app.
